verses.author: model_A
verses.text: She folds the letter twice before deciding not to send it.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the crease holds longer
than her certainty did—
a drawer closes soft

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
dust settles on the wood
where her hand lingered—
the ink still waits inside

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
morning light finds
the same corner of the desk—
nothing has moved, but the shadow has

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the shadow leans
toward the door now, patient
as an unspoken word

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the door stays shut, still—
someone forgot which side
the waiting was on

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a draft in the wind
carries the smell of rain
before the knock comes

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the knock comes twice—
once for the hand, once
for what it means to arrive

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the latch lifts easy
though no one taught it
the shape of arriving

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the hinge remembers
what the hand forgets—
a small creak of welcome

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the door swings wide
and the room exhales
its held breath of dust

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
light finds the corners
that waiting kept dark—
even dust has somewhere to settle

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a chair angled
toward whoever might come—
still keeping its patience

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the chair's shadow lengthens
across the floor's silence—
someone almost sat here

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the almost-sitter's warmth
still clings to the empty air—
the room forgets no one
